profile.headline: Customer Focused Software Engineer, Cat Herder, General Nerd
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer (and sometimes engineering manager) focused on user experience, integrations, and bridging the gap for non-technical partners. I care deeply about building systems that make work easier, not harder.

My leadership style is rooted in conscious leadership and active listening. I’m passionate about supporting the people who report to me and creating space for them to do their best work. My favorite coaching sessions often turn into collaborative rubber-duck debugging.

I love working cross-functionally with teams that cultivate a learning culture and genuinely care about their users (not all users are external customers!). Solving tricky problems in logic and user experience never gets old. I have a healthy dislike for “magic” code and short-lived programming fads.

Buzzwords you may care about: React, Ruby on Rails, Python, Git, AWS, LLMs, accounting systems, data pipelines/ETL/visualization, UI/UX, project management, engineering management, and a tendency to overuse emojis. 🐈

Outside of work, I’m always looking for ways to support underprivileged groups in and out of tech. When I grow up, I’d like to be the trusted sidekick of a superhero.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Helped build an AI-powered Slack bot from the ground up using OpenAI and Claude, serving as sole full-time engineer across the full development lifecycle
- Built contract enrichment pipelines leveraging Gemini, integrated with Ironclad for contract lifecycle management
- Developed financial data integrations across NetSuite and Zip, automating workflows and reducing manual overhead across the business
- Acted as technical lead across multiple product pivots, owning architecture decisions and implementation end-to-end

positions.title: Caregiving
positions.description: I took some time off to be a family caregiver, focus on my own physical and mental health, and refocus on what I want to pour my energy into.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Built an internal operations engineering team from scratch
- Managed a diverse team of engineers and data professionals
- Coordinated an updated financial billing system to increase the reliability and accuracy of enterprise billing and accounting workflows

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
- Worked cross-functionally as a bridge between engineering and leadership in go-to-market departments
- Lead the creation of a comprehensive, company-wide data infrastructure that bridges all data sources and downstream business insight tools in the company
- Created and managed GDPR, CPRA, and other general data privacy processes and internal documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on independent product research projects, working closely with design and product leaders to test assumptions and scale user onboarding
- Built multiple usability features to delight customers and actively monitored accessibility and workflows

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Managing a dedicated full-stack team focused on user experience and internal tools across teams
- Built the engineering recruiting process as we scaled from 10 employees to 100

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for building the initial application (React, WebRTC) from the first launch through multiple series of funding
- Built initial payment flows that allowed our content creators to make money on our platform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Converted our billing system to a Stripe integration for both charging our clients and paying writers
- Rebuilt our writer platform and onboarding process, improving writer quality and turnaround time
- Worked with marketing to create a viral content marketing quiz that led to a 10% increase in leads

positions.title: Software Engineer Full Stack
positions.description: Supporting an amazing team trying to change the game in education. One of two content engineers, which means focusing more on facilitating external partnerships and integrating our partners' and our processes.

positions.title: Administrative Specialist
positions.description: Project management and coordination between all departments of a government insurance pool. Front desk and customer service skills. Newsletter and webpage creation, database management. Technical documentation of internal processes and staff training of internal software. Coordination for monthly staff events and annual conference.

volunteerExperiences.description: Technical mentor for a couple of awesome women working to become software engineers. Spent time helping them with their questions and projects and also just talking about what life is like in being a software engineer.
